headline: YOUR TRACKS GET A NAME
lede: The design bay can name your course — the letter wheel is open. Twelve letters, A to Z plus a space, and the attract marquee flies the badge you wrote: DEMO · SKATEPARK instead of DEMO · CUSTOM 1. The roster, the splash rows and the save receipts all speak your design's name; designs saved before naming keep the old byte-honest grammar.

notes.text: The NAME tool (before SAVE): arrows walk a 27-glyph wheel, A commits, the pad's new DEL button takes one back — one pad, no new axes. The 13th letter refuses by name.
The attract badge now rides the design's own name; MOTOCROSS is untouchable and unnamed designs read exactly as before (CUSTOM k), so every pre-naming save is byte-honest.
Grounding win: by-hand shots proved SAVE/EXIT were already running off the 256px canvas at eleven tools — at twelve the strip steps down to 6px and every verb is finally visible.

excitecheck 451/451 (+25, two mutants die by name); exciteplay 151/151 (+14 real-key naming drive). The :350 toast-drain wait still flakes locally while CI nightly is green — named in STATE, not chased.

look.text: Name a track and watch it ride the marquee — press 0, walk the wheel, save.
